subject: Support hiring at Ledgerloop
body:
Hi Maya,

Ledgerloop posted a Customer Support Specialist role on 2026-10-24. Teams growing support often start by taking repetitive tickets off the queue. SupportPilot automatically resolves up to 45% of inbound tickets for teams handling more than 5,000 tickets per month. Would a short call next week be useful?
